name: NeuroContent
author: NIA

sections.description:
NeuroContent is a powerful AI content generator for WordPress designed to help you create, schedule, approve, and publish SEO-optimized articles automatically.

Powered by OpenAI, the plugin generates high-quality content and AI images directly inside WordPress — without switching tools or copy/paste workflows.

From idea to publication in minutes.
NeuroContent works as a WordPress content automation plugin that can generate, approve, and publish articles automatically.

🚀 What NeuroContent Can Do

✓ Generate Complete SEO Articles in Seconds
Create long-form blog posts, affiliate content, product descriptions, news articles, and more using customizable prompts.

✓ Create AI Images Inside WordPress
Generate unique featured images, thumbnails, and illustrations automatically from text prompts.

✓ Automate Publishing with Smart Triggers
Schedule automatic article generation:
– Hourly
– Daily
– Weekly
– Custom intervals

Perfect for content scaling and niche websites.

✓ NEW – Email Article Approval & Control

Review generated articles directly from your email inbox.

You can:
– ✅ Approve article
– ❌ Delete article

No need to log into WordPress.
One click from your email and the action is executed instantly.

Perfect for agencies and editorial workflows.

✓ NEW – Facebook Auto Posting (Social Share)

Connect your Facebook account and automatically publish or schedule posts to your Facebook Pages.

Social Share features:
– Publish instantly when article goes live
– Schedule Facebook posts
– Select specific Facebook Pages
– Control posting directly from the Gutenberg / Classic Editor meta box
– Grow traffic automatically while publishing content.

✓ NEW – Web Search for AI Articles

NeuroContent can search the internet for factual information before generating an article.

When Web Search is enabled for a trigger, the AI can gather real-time context before writing content. This improves accuracy and helps generate articles based on current information.

Search provider:
– OpenAI Web Search

Useful for topics such as:
– economic news
– market trends
– industry developments
– public policy changes
– fast-moving events

Web Search runs automatically during article generation when enabled in trigger settings.

✓ NEW – AI Content Analytics Dashboard (PRO)

NeuroContent PRO includes a built-in Analytics dashboard that helps you understand how your AI content system performs.

The Analytics tab shows:

  • number of generated articles
  • token usage
  • AI generation costs
  • image generation usage
  • success and error rates
  • performance metrics

This helps you monitor your AI content workflow directly inside WordPress.

The free version displays a limited analytics overview, while NeuroContent PRO unlocks the full analytics dashboard and detailed insights.

✓ Native WordPress Integration

  • Works with Gutenberg & Classic Editor
  • Works with any theme or page builder
  • No coding required
  • Built for performance

🎯 Built For

  • Bloggers
  • SEO professionals
  • Affiliate marketers
  • Agencies
  • News publishers
  • E-commerce stores
  • Automated content websites

If you need scalable content production inside WordPress — NeuroContent PRO is your publishing engine.

AI Content Generator for WordPress

NeuroContent is a WordPress AI plugin that helps generate AI articles, automate content publishing, create AI images, and scale content production using OpenAI.

It can be used for:

  • AI article generation
  • automated blog content
  • SEO article writing
  • AI powered publishing workflows
  • automated content websites
  • WordPress AI content automation

🔧 Core Features

⭐ AI Article Generator

  • Long-form SEO articles
  • Custom tone & structure
  • Keyword control
  • Heading structure (H1–H3 optimized)

⭐ AI Image Generator

  • Generate featured images from prompts
  • Unique visuals per article
  • Direct WordPress media integration

⭐ Automated Content Scheduling (Triggers)

  • Fully automated article creation
  • Recurring publishing intervals
  • Hands-free content production

⭐ Web Search for AI Articles (NEW)

  • Enable internet search before article generation
  • Gather real-time information for better context
  • Improve factual accuracy in AI-generated content
  • Works automatically inside triggers
  • Powered by OpenAI Web Search

⭐ Email-Based Article Approval (NEW)

  • Approve or delete generated articles via email
  • One-click secure action links
  • Ideal for editorial review workflows

⭐ Facebook Social Share Automation (NEW)

  • Connect Facebook account
  • Post automatically to Facebook Pages
  • Schedule social posts
  • Configure per article inside editor
  • Boost organic reach automatically

⭐ AI Analytics Dashboard (PRO)

Monitor your AI content system directly inside WordPress.

The Analytics tab provides:

  • article generation statistics
  • token usage tracking
  • estimated AI cost monitoring
  • image generation metrics
  • trigger success and error tracking
  • performance insights for automated content workflows

The free version shows a simplified overview, while PRO unlocks the full analytics dashboard and advanced metrics.

⭐ Editor Meta Box Control

  • Generate content with one click
  • Control AI settings per post
  • Publish or schedule social sharing
  • Works inside Gutenberg and Classic Editor

🧠 Why Choose NeuroContent PRO?

  • All-in-one AI content automation
  • SEO-friendly article generation
  • Automated publishing workflows
  • Social media automation included
  • Saves hours of manual work
  • Scales content production affordably

NeuroContent PRO is not just an AI writer. It also includes an AI analytics dashboard that helps monitor token usage, article generation, and automation performance.
It’s a complete WordPress automation system.

👉 Upgrade to NeuroContent PRO to unlock advanced editorial approval workflows and full automation control.

External Services

This plugin connects to the OpenAI API (api.openai.com) to generate text and images based on your prompts.

🔹 What service is used?

OpenAI API – https://api.openai.com
Used for:
– Text generation (articles, titles, summaries)
– Image generation
– Optional web search used during article generation when enabled

🔹 What data is sent and when?

Data is sent only when you click a “Generate” button or manually trigger AI creation.
The plugin sends:

  • Your text prompt
  • Optional content you choose to include (titles, descriptions)
  • Selected model and generation options
  • No personal user data is sent automatically

No background requests are made without user action.

🔹 Legal information

OpenAI Terms of Use
https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use

OpenAI Privacy Policy
https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy

OpenAI may receive standard HTTP metadata (e.g. IP address) according to their policy.

No automatic posting without user configuration.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin in Plugins → Installed Plugins
  3. Open NeuroContent AI in your WordPress Dashboard
  4. Add your OpenAI API key
  5. Start generating articles and images instantly
sections.faq:
What do I need?

An OpenAI API key. Optional: Facebook account for Social Share.

Can I approve articles by email?

Yes. When enabled, you can approve or delete generated articles directly from your email inbox.

Does it automatically post to Facebook?

Yes. After connecting your account, you can publish or schedule posts to your Facebook Pages.

Is content unique?

Yes. Each AI generation request produces unique output.

Does it work with Gutenberg?

Yes. Full integration via dedicated meta box.

Does it work with Classic Editor?

Yes. Automatically supported.

Can NeuroContent search the internet before generating articles?

Yes. When Web Search is enabled for a trigger, NeuroContent can search the internet for factual information before generating the article. This helps produce more accurate and up-to-date content.

Does NeuroContent include analytics for AI content generation?

Yes. NeuroContent includes an Analytics tab that displays activity and performance data for AI-generated content.
The free version shows basic statistics, while NeuroContent PRO unlocks the full analytics dashboard with detailed metrics such as token usage, costs, and performance insights.

  • Major update: introduced the new Free + Pro add-on architecture.
  • Added stronger WordPress.org compatibility cleanup across core plugin files.
  • Improved code quality, escaping, sanitization, and plugin check readiness.
  • Updated internal file formatting for cleaner WordPress coding standards compliance.
  • Prepared the plugin foundation for future Pro features and safer long-term updates.

1.1.0

  • Reduced procedural helper complexity to improve maintainability, feature separation, and long-term extensibility for AI/LLM-driven content automation.

1.0.9

Adds smart deactivation feedback collection with improved analytics insights and performance tracking.

1.0.8

  • Added full support for OpenAI GPT Image models for improved image generation quality
  • Updated image size handling with automatic migration from legacy DALL·E formats

1.0.7

  • Fix: Resolved a fatal activation error caused by a missing function neurocontent_create_logs_table(), which triggered:

1.0.6

  • New Feature: Web Search support for AI article generation using OpenAI Web Search.
  • New PRO Feature: AI Content Analytics dashboard with detailed metrics for token usage, article generation, costs, and workflow performance.

1.0.5

  • New PRO Feature: Social Share integration for automatic Facebook posting.

1.0.4

  • Improved prompt handling and sanitization for maximum stability and data integrity.
  • Enhanced support for long, multi-line AI prompts with consistent line endings.
  • Prevented accidental loss of trigger prompts when saving settings.
  • Optimized internal data handling to ensure reliable storage of complex prompt content.
  • General hardening of settings logic for improved reliability in advanced configurations.

1.0.3

  • New PRO Feature: One-Click Article Approval via secure email notifications.

1.0.2

  • New Feature: You can pick ChatGPT model

1.0.1
